text:
Lily: Found a tiny rubber duck on the projector table in Meeting Room C. Anyone missing a mascot? :duck:
Alex: Not mine but now I want it. Tiny ducks are my weakness. :eyes:
Priya: Omg, adopt it. Name suggestions: Conference Quack, Quacky, or Sir Ducksworth.
Ken: I vote for 'Sir Ducksworth' purely for the dignity. Also: who leaves ducks near HDMI cables? :man_shrugging:
Sam: Photo attached in the room — it has a tiny sticker that says `v1.2` :laughing:
Jamie: I put it at the front desk for safekeeping. If no owner by Friday, we have an office ritual to name it. :raised_hands:
Alex: Also propose a tiny bow tie. Mandatory. :bowtie: :+1:
ops-bot: Poll started by Lily — options: Quacky / Sir Ducksworth / Conference Quack. React with :one: :two: or :three:. Poll ends in 1 hour.
Priya: :two: (Sir Ducksworth)
Ken: :two:
Sam: :two:
Lily: :two:
ops-bot: Poll ended. Results — Sir Ducksworth: 4 votes. Quacky: 0. Conference Quack: 0.
Jamie: Officially Sir Ducksworth. Naming ceremony scheduled Friday 4pm in Meeting Room C (5 min). All welcome for ceremonial applause and snacks. :tada:
Lily: If anyone claims him before then, please bring a tiny bow tie and a short bio. Otherwise, Sir Ducksworth will be inducted into the office mascot registry. :duck:
